subject: Trump's call to C-SPAN
title: Did Trump call into C-SPAN? Yes, on Nov. 9, 2026: what he said
answer: Yes. President Donald Trump phoned into C-SPAN on Monday night, Nov. 9, 2026, during the premiere of the new show "Washington Journal Primetime," hosted by Mimi Geerges. He came on about 10 minutes into the program and talked about viewer call-ins, the Hegseth impeachment push and the Iran war.
body:
Trump told Geerges he watches C-SPAN's call-in segments because "it gives me a little bit of an indication of where we are," adding that Republican callers seemed pleased and Democrats less so. He said he would be disappointed in Republicans who vote to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, saying, "Pete has won two wars," and discussed the war with Iran, saying "We could knock it out fast." He also talked about deportation policy.

The call was the latest in a run of surprise media appearances after the Nov. 3 midterm elections. Earlier, after a Supreme Court tariff ruling, C-SPAN said a viral caller who identified himself as "John Barron" was not Trump, so many people searched to check whether this call was real. This one was real: it aired during the show, and outlets including CNBC reported on it.
in_the_news: Searches for "trump calls cspan" and "did trump call into cspan" broke out on Nov. 10, 2026, after the call.
